modern: Do not let future things disturb you, for you will come to them, if it must be so, carrying with you the same reason which you now use for present things.
original: Let not future things disturb thee, for thou wilt come to them, if it shall be necessary, having with thee the same reason which now thou usest for present things.
notification: Do not let future things disturb you, for you will come to them, if it must be so, carrying with you the same reason which you now use for present things.
notification_original: Let not future things disturb thee, for thou wilt come to them, if it shall be necessary, having with thee the same reason which now thou usest for present things.

explained.summary: Don’t let the future unsettle you. If you get there, you’ll bring with you the same reason and judgement you’re using right now on the present. You already have the tools; you don’t need to fight tomorrow’s battles today.
explained.today: Lying awake rehearsing next week’s difficult conversation or a possible redundancy rarely helps. You will face it, if it comes, with the same good sense you’re using today on today’s problems.
